policy: Fresh v8 ingestion with complete historical source review. Inputs over 180000 serialized characters use lossless 16000-character units, up to 64 units/64000 source characters per batch and 16 batches. At most three workers share the existing 90-second model deadline. Screen every unit, adjudicate all nominated full messages and neighbors globally, then review every original unit against the fixed target. Missing, uncertain or adopted closure rows reject the whole write. Commit revalidates full coverage and fingerprint atomically. Large global context or closure input still fails explicitly at 180000 characters; no truncation. Source-only rejection cannot modify linked human facts, and future replay boundaries remain pending. Extraction/verification/repair use gpt-5.5; fixed mini Answer/Judge and 32-item/6000-token evidence budget. This candidate has no demonstrated benchmark improvement. All failed attempts and questions remain recorded; exposed development backgrounds are not holdouts. Three full paired repeats and new data validation remain required.
